body.en: By default the relay listens on 127.0.0.1 only. No public port is opened unless you change the bind address, and the target server still sees an ordinary Minecraft client.
body.zh: 默认情况下中继只监听 127.0.0.1，不向公网开放端口（除非你修改绑定地址）；目标服务器看到的仍然是一个普通的 Minecraft 客户端。

body.en: Handshakes from clients that support wss:// or ws:// are recognised and answered; vanilla Java clients pass through unchanged.
body.zh: 识别并应答支持 wss:// 或 ws:// 的客户端握手；原版 Java 客户端直接透传。

body.en: A self-signed certificate is created on first run and can be installed into the Windows trust store with one click.
body.zh: 首次运行生成自签名证书，可一键安装到 Windows 信任存储。

body.en: Offline accounts need no sign-in. Microsoft sign-in uses the device-code flow with a built-in public client ID. A compatible third-party account service can be added with the API root from its provider.
body.zh: 离线账号无需登录。微软登录走设备代码流程，使用内置公开客户端 ID；也可以填入兼容的第三方账号服务提供的 API 根地址。

body.en: The relay parses the Minecraft protocol, rewrites what a browser cannot send, and keeps the session compatible with Forge, NeoForge and Fabric.
body.zh: 中继解析 Minecraft 协议，补上浏览器发不出的部分，并兼容 Forge、NeoForge 和 Fabric。

body.en: A loopback-only browser control panel for settings, logs, accounts and certificates. The desktop window is the same UI in a native webview.
body.zh: 仅回环的浏览器控制面板，用于设置、日志、账号和证书；桌面窗口就是同一套界面的原生 WebView。

body.en: The /mcp endpoint speaks JSON-RPC 2.0 over Streamable HTTP and exposes 39 tools, resources and prompts for AI clients -- status, config (including appearance and path routes), service control, logs, accounts, certificates, updates, auth, and UI preferences.
body.zh: /mcp 端点通过 Streamable HTTP 提供 JSON-RPC 2.0，为 AI 客户端暴露 39 个工具、resources 和 prompts——状态、配置（含外观和路径路由）、服务控制、日志、账号、证书、更新、密码与界面偏好。

body.en: Every status query goes to the target server; there is no cached MOTD.
body.zh: 每次状态查询都直达目标服务器；不缓存 MOTD。

body.en: Optionally treat the request path as the target server: /mc244.com -> mc244.com, /hypixel.net -> hypixel.net, /127.0.0.1:25565 -> 127.0.0.1:25565. Mutually exclusive with the path-route table.
body.zh: 可把连接路径本身当作目标服务器：/mc244.com -> mc244.com，/hypixel.net -> hypixel.net，/127.0.0.1:25565 -> 127.0.0.1:25565。与路径映射互斥，不能同时开启。
